//: EXPO_PUBLIC_* values are declared here on purpose.
Expo inlines them into the JS bundle at BUILD time, and an EAS build runs
on Expo's servers from a git clone -- where client/.env does not exist,
because it is gitignored. Without these, EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is undefined,
src/constants/env.ts throws at module load, and the build installs and
crashes on the splash screen with no useful message.
Declaring them is safe: EXPO_PUBLIC_ values ship inside the bundle on every
device regardless, so they are public by definition. Anything genuinely
secret belongs in `eas secret:create`, never here.
